note.en: A foreign diploma must be evaluated by Inholland's CSA to verify equivalence with a Dutch diploma (havo, vwo or mbo-4); send your diploma and transcript before 1 May 2025.

evidence.quote: Heb je een diploma buiten Nederland behaald dan moet onder meer worden beoordeeld of dit gelijkwaardig is aan een Nederlands havo-, vwo- of mbo-diploma niveau 4.

notes: Tuition fee proposed is the institution-wide institutional fee (instellingscollegegeld) for full-time (voltijd) students in 2027-2028, for students who do not meet the conditions for the statutory fee (EU/EEA/Swiss/Surinamese nationality). The programme's own page does not state a tuition fee. The applying student is a non-EU Moroccan with a foreign diploma, so this institutional fee is the relevant one. The pages do not state a programme-specific application deadline for non-EU applicants; the general deadline 1 May 2025 in the In- en uitschrijfregels is for 2025-2026 and not clearly tied to this programme, so no intake fact is included. Documents: the identity document requirement is an enrolment condition; a school-leaving certificate and final transcript are requested for international diploma applicants. The Dutch language requirement B2 is stated on the Creative Business English entry requirements page and in the In- en uitschrijfregels (par. 2.12) applies to Dutch-taught programmes; for this Dutch-taught Accountancy programme it is relevant.
